svg.text: ER diagram · the complete Closet database
PostgreSQL 16, one schema per module (migrations 001 – 005). Every table carries user_id → accounts.users (ON DELETE CASCADE). 1 ──< many; rose text = added in v1.3 / v1.4.
dress codes 1–5, ≥ 1 dress code per piece
deletions keep the reason, never the photo
reason ∈ Torn / damaged · No longer my style
Outfits, feedback, Closet Intelligence, shopping and packing

g.text: How the data closes the loop
item_ids reference wardrobe.items (array of ids, checked by the Outfits service on write)

svg.text: wardrobe.items ← item_ids of outfits, wears, feedback, trips
